title: The scrub refresh speed check stops failing main when a CI runner is busy
goal: Main's checks went red on 2026-11-19 because one speed test compared two raw timings taken a moment apart on a busy CI machine, and the smaller-picture one happened to read slower. The test should only fail when drawing at the shown size really is no cheaper than drawing at full size.
notes:
CI run https://github.com/dzearing/photonz/actions/runs/44611675341 (commit df4edff9d). `gh run view 44611675341 --log-failed | grep -E '✘'` printed:
✘ Test "At the size it is shown, a scrub refresh composites well inside a 60 hertz frame" recorded an issue at ScrubCompositePerfTests.swift:99:9: Expectation failed: (shown → 58.762917) < (full → 48.742)
Calibration machine reads 17ms full, 7.5ms shown; the runner read 48.7 full and 58.8 shown, so the runner was ~3x slower and swinging. `shown` is checkFrames' rawMS (interleaved with the 1080p yardstick, which itself loads the GPU), `full` is a plain median taken earlier without a yardstick, so the two readings are not like for like. The preceding two runs on main (44586497514, 44569490885) were green. Found by the runner on find-out-why-exporting-a-video-holds-about-4-gb, which does not touch this test.
acceptance: The scrub refresh test no longer compares two raw wall-clock readings taken at different moments on a loaded machine (judge both beside the same ruler, or interleave the two sizes)
Test slice 1 of 3 passes on main again

log.note: owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Reproduced from the CI log of 44611675341: full 48.7ms read alone first, shown 58.8ms read later beside a ruler at 27.5ms (8x its own 3.3ms). Chose a per-round paired ratio (median of shown/full, order alternating, each on its own timed renderer, ruler in the same round) over two separate gated readings, because pairing cancels whatever load the machine has at that moment; the shown-size budget is judged from the same rounds. Local: 0.68; 8 copies at once x3: 24/24 pass, worst 0.92; earlier green CI read 0.43-0.6.

Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/ScrubCompositePerfTests.swift now draws the ruler, the full size and the shown size back to back in each of 29 rounds and fails only if the median per-round shown/full ratio is 1 or more; the shown size is still gated against 7.5ms from the same rounds. Commit 11c1116f3. Scripts/test.sh green; 24/24 under 8x local contention; CI run 44630821614 all three slices green (ratio 0.59 on the runner, ruler at 6.6x).
